name: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept
prerequisites: master in either Arcana or Nature and expert in the other
text: You refine your halcyon magic. You gain two common 4th-rank halcyon spells and two 5th-rank halcyon spells. You also gain a 4th-rank halcyon spell slot and a 5th-rank halcyon spell slot. Your proficiency rank in either arcane or primal spell DCs and spell attack rolls advances from trained to expert.
